info.title: eTroy One API
info.description: OIDC provider, identity lifecycle and administration. The 87 original API Explorer scenarios are preserved as named examples and x-explorer-cases. Replace {{placeholders}} before executing requests. Browser login establishes the same-origin session cookie; copy the etroy_oidc_csrf cookie value to x-oidc-csrf-token for logout. Admin context is inherited from upstream and is not a complete authorization mechanism. Do not expose this development configuration publicly.

- **40 Compromised Token Family**: Expected: Reuse detection blocks compromised token family.
- **41 Concurrent Refresh Check**: Expected: Concurrent refresh behavior is controlled.
- **44 Revoked Refresh Reuse**: Expected: Revoked refresh token cannot be used.
- **87 JWT Header Contains KID**: Expected: JWT header includes kid for key identification.
